runtimeParity: All recorded runtime application files match the verified live snapshot.

sourceVariants.packaging: Explicit public-only preview mode; full media validation preserved.
sourceVariants.publicationCheck: Narrow path allowlist for audited infrastructure source and existing sanitized evidence; credential scans retained.
